description: Why the trader is passing on a symbol for today. v5 (2026-09-29) words the level reasons the other way up on a SHORT chart, at the trader's request: 'invert the rules for shorts. SMA incoming and horizontal overhead should mean the same thing but inverted.' Optional short_label/short_hint are shown when the side is SHORT. Codes, long labels, hints and hotkeys carry over byte-identical from v4, so every forward record keeps pooling.

reasons.label: Incoming trendline
reasons.hint: A descending/ascending line arrives at price soon enough to matter today.
reasons.short_hint: A rising line arrives under price soon enough to catch the drop today.

reasons.label: SMA incoming
reasons.hint: A moving average arrives at price soon enough to cap or catch the move today.
reasons.short_hint: A moving average sits just under price, close enough to catch the drop today.

reasons.label: Overhead horizontal
reasons.hint: A horizontal level sits close enough above to cap the move.
reasons.short_hint: A horizontal level sits close enough below to stop the drop.

reasons.label: Compressed
reasons.hint: Range has coiled too tight to offer a workable move from here.

reasons.label: Sector mate earnings pending
reasons.hint: A peer reports before this name would resolve.

reasons.label: Too extended from base
reasons.hint: Price has already travelled too far from its base to start here.
reasons.short_hint: Price has already fallen too far from its base to short here.

reasons.label: Volume dry
reasons.hint: Not enough participation to trust the move.

reasons.label: Earnings too close
reasons.hint: This name's own report lands inside the intended hold.

reasons.label: Spread / liquidity
reasons.hint: The spread or depth makes the risk unmanageable.

reasons.label: Bad industry
reasons.hint: The whole group is one the trader avoids right now, e.g. oil and gas or real estate.

reasons.label: Too early
reasons.hint: The bounce is only starting - one green candle. It needs more time to prove itself.
reasons.short_hint: The fade is only starting - one red candle. It needs more time to prove itself.

reasons.label: Not remotely good
reasons.hint: The call makes no sense on the chart, e.g. a short on a name at all-time highs that is only red for the day.

reasons.label: Other (note required)
reasons.hint: Anything not covered above. The note is what makes this row usable later.
